title: Short-term hiring timed to funded courses (simulated)
theme: How might an employer and a provider align hiring and course cohorts so that grant support, rather than the job, drives the hire?
disclaimer: SIMULATED RISK HYPOTHESIS. Produced by scripted/LLM agents role-playing incentives; it is NOT evidence that any person or organisation has behaved this way. Social media excerpts are unverified. Human approval means 'worth testing against data', not a finding of fact.
